findings.title: Truncated Apache license header in spending.py
findings.problem: The Apache header at the top of spending.py stops at '# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and' (line 12) and omits the closing '# limitations under the License.' line; line 13 is blank. The other 11 package files carry the full 13-line header, and AC1 requires the Apache header on every module.
findings.impact: AC1 is unmet and a malformed license notice ships in a new source file. Confirmed by reading the file. Per the verification-gap lens, scripts/license_headers/check_license_headers.py only matches Apache marker strings, so make ruff and the license check will not flag it.
findings.recommendation: Append the missing final header line `# limitations under the License.` directly after line 12 of spending.py, so the header matches the 13-line header in the other 11 package files. Change nothing else in the file.
